# Synthetic audio fixture

`silence-aac.m4a` contains 0.5 seconds of generated silence, mono AAC at 44.1 kHz,
encoded by macOS `afconvert` (`-f m4af -d aac -b 64000`) from an all-zero PCM WAV.
It contains no microphone, user or third-party recording. The complete real M4A
container is retained so PHP/libmagic detects its actual media type; this is not
an extension-only or mocked MIME test. The observed macOS PHP/libmagic signature
is `audio/x-m4a`; canonical MP4-family signatures are also valid across platforms.


## Synthetic HEIC fixture

`synthetic-heic.heic` is a 640×480 green checkerboard generated by macOS ImageIO
through `sips -s format heic`, from a synthetic PNG used by Narzan's UI tests.
It contains no camera image, personal content, or camera metadata. The complete
880-byte HEVC-in-HEIF container is retained for real `finfo` detection; the observed
signature is `image/heic`. The tests also send these same bytes with `.heif` and
declared `image/heif`, verifying the server uses the detected canonical type.
Generic `image/heif` is not added to the album whitelist without a genuine
fixture producing that detected signature. SVG and arbitrary declared image
MIMEs remain excluded.
